dialog.title: Verify phone
dialog.intro: Optional. Confirms the patient's phone with a code so their basic details can be linked to an AltCare profile. Treatment never depends on it.
dialog.introPrefill: Optional. Confirms the patient's phone with a code, so you can fill in their details from an existing AltCare profile or start a new one. Treatment never depends on it.

phone.label: Patient's mobile number
phone.hint: A Bangladesh mobile, like 01XXXXXXXXX. AltCare pays for the SMS.
phone.invalid: Enter a Bangladesh mobile number, like 01XXXXXXXXX.

consent.title: Read this aloud to the patient
consent.scriptBn: আমরা আপনার ফোনে একটি কোড পাঠাচ্ছি। কোডটি বললে আপনি রাজি হচ্ছেন যে {clinic}-এর সঙ্গে আপনার মূল তথ্য (নাম, বয়স, লিঙ্গ, এলাকা) AltCare প্রোফাইলে যুক্ত হবে। আপনার চিকিৎসার তথ্য আপনার অনুমতি ছাড়া অন্য কোনো ডাক্তারের কাছে যাবে না। রাজি না হলে কোড দেবেন না, তবুও চিকিৎসা পাবেন।
consent.scriptEn: We are sending a code to your phone. By telling us the code, you agree that your basic details (name, age, gender, area) will be linked to your AltCare profile with {clinic}. Your medical information will not go to any other doctor without your permission. If you do not agree, do not give the code. You will still get treatment.

code.scriptRead: I read this to the patient
code.label: Code the patient reads out
code.needBoth: Tick the box and enter the 6-digit code to continue.

person.findHelp: Type the visitor's name. Only matching profiles are shown.
person.noResults: No matching profile. You can add this person as new below.
person.linkedHere: Already has a record at this clinic.
person.noProfiles: No profile exists for this phone yet. Add this person as new.
person.newPersonHelp: Creates a profile from the details saved in this clinic's record. Nothing medical is shared.
person.relationshipLabel: Who is this for the phone holder?
person.birthYearHelp: Use it if there is no date of birth, like 1985.

done.title: Phone verified and linked
done.body: This record is now linked to the AltCare profile of {name}.

revoke.title: Remove the link?
revoke.body: The record will no longer be linked to the patient's AltCare profile. The clinic keeps its own record of the patient.

prefill.verifiedNote: Phone verified — will be linked when saved.
prefill.linkFailed: The patient was saved, but linking failed: {reason} You can verify from the patient's page.

claim.intro: Enter your phone number and the claim code your clinic gave you.
claim.consent: I agree to link my basic details (name, age, gender, area) to my AltCare profile for this clinic. My medical information is not shared with any other doctor without my permission.
claim.success: Your record at {clinic} is now linked
claim.successBody: Linked to the profile of {name}. You can close this page.
